item.title: Trained Healthcare Simulation Observers Can Improve Learner Outcomes
item.description: A trained healthcare simulation observer is an individual who receives focused instruction prior to clinical simulation on the specific elements they are expected to assess and report. item.title: How Environmental Triggers Enhance Healthcare Simulation Learning Outcomes
item.description: Environmental triggers are a powerful yet often overlooked method to introduce real-world complexity into healthcare simulations. Unlike patients or family members, environmental triggers are scripted elements that function within the system rather than as part of the clinical interaction itself. The environmental triggers might represent equipment that malfunctions intermittently, administrative gatekeeping, workflow bottlenecks, missing supplies, […]
